actions.action: Separate page selection from all matching records
actions.mechanism: Explicit scope choices prevent a page checkbox from silently selecting records on other pages.
actions.implementation: Offer “Select these 25 records” and “Select all 600 matching records.” Keep scope, exclusions, and target status visible beside confirmation.
actions.check: With keyboard and screen reader, verify each choice announces its count and confirmation names the selected scope.
actions.risk: Counts alone can conceal which filters defined the selection.

actions.mechanism: An immutable ID manifest prevents changing filters or newly matching records from expanding an operation.
actions.implementation: Resolve selection into explicit IDs before confirmation. Store the confirmed manifest; submit only its IDs and enforce membership server-side.
actions.check: Change filters and add matching records after confirmation; verify every submitted ID belongs to the original manifest.
actions.risk: Resolving large selections may require a loading state before confirmation.

actions.mechanism: Atomic version checks prevent bulk edits from overwriting intervening changes without informed confirmation.
actions.implementation: Capture record versions with the manifest. Extend the write path to condition each update on its confirmed version; return conflicts separately.
actions.check: Modify a record after confirmation but before its write; verify it remains untouched and receives a conflict outcome.
actions.risk: Requires conditional writes, not a separate preflight check.

actions.action: Keep a durable per-record operation ledger
actions.mechanism: Recorded outcomes distinguish completed writes, failures, and unresolved requests throughout a long-running operation.
actions.implementation: Persist the manifest, target status, and per-ID outcomes under an operation ID. Show completed, failed, pending, and unknown counts.
actions.check: Disconnect midway and reopen the operation; verify known outcomes persist and unresolved requests are not labeled failed.
actions.risk: Lost responses require server reconciliation before safe recovery.

actions.mechanism: Outcome-based retry sets exclude successes; idempotency prevents duplicate execution when request delivery is uncertain.
actions.implementation: Build retry IDs from confirmed-manifest failures. Reconcile unknown outcomes, reuse per-record idempotency keys, and require refreshed confirmation for conflicts.
actions.check: Simulate mixed outcomes and a lost response; verify retry never reapplies a success or includes an unconfirmed ID.
actions.risk: Conflict recovery must not silently authorize overwriting newer changes.

actions.action: Explain and enforce reversal eligibility per record
actions.mechanism: Time and version checks allow safe reversal while exposing specific reasons a record cannot be restored.
actions.implementation: Store prior status, resulting version, and policy deadline. Atomically check both eligibility conditions; display “Time expired” or “Changed afterward” per record.
actions.check: Reverse unchanged, subsequently edited, and expired records; verify only eligible records revert and every rejection has a reason.
actions.risk: Eligibility can change between display and reversal execution.

actions.action: Make the entire operation keyboard and screen-reader usable
actions.mechanism: Semantic controls, predictable focus, and restrained announcements expose scope and recovery without relying on visual cues.
actions.implementation: Use labeled checkboxes, keyboard-operable scope controls, a confirmation summary, polite progress announcements, and searchable per-record results with textual reasons.
actions.check: Without a pointer, select across pages, confirm, locate a failure, retry it, and inspect an unavailable reversal using a screen reader.
actions.risk: Announcing every record completion would overwhelm meaningful feedback.
